source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Γεώργιος ο εν Κρήνη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its own heading reads «Αγιος Γεωργιος ο Εν Κρηνη (; - 1823)». None of the corpus's Georges is of Krene or was hanged in 1823, and the narrative is particular enough to tell him apart: born in the parts of Attaleia, snatched as an infant by an Aga called Prousalis and named Mehmet, undeceived by a Christian servant called Maria, married at Krene to Helen Mavrogianne. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
